children: Circle Internet Group's Chief Financial Officer Jeremy Fox-Geen is stepping down by the end of the year.

The cryptocurrency company said Friday that Fox-Geen plans to depart after more than five years in the position. He will stay on through the end of December unless a successor is appointed before then.
Circle said it had engaged a search firm and initiated a search for a new CFO.
"Having achieved many milestones, it is now the right time for me to step down and take a break before my next chapter," Fox-Geen said.
Write to Elias Schisgall at elias.schisgall@wsj.com
